attempted_claim: The intercalate-free (N2-free) stratum of Latin squares of order 8 contains exactly N isotopy classes (N fixed by the run), each exhibited by an explicit representative with an exhaustive 784 row-column-pair N2-freeness log and a certified autotopism group order; the classes partition across the 3 known N2-free main classes in a stated distribution, all replayable from canonical isotopy hashes.
claim_type: isotopy census with intercalate-freeness certificates and autotopism stratification
decisive_failure: correctness: Stored grids in inputs/artifacts/class_table.json are all Latin and N2=0 (independently recomputed: 12/12 Latin OK, N2=0 OK), transversal counts 48/56/66 and autotopism orders 2/4/1 all replay OK, and pairwise non-isotopy holds for all 10 A-pairs, all 10 B-pairs and C-pair (iso_count=0, ~1.3s each) plus sampled autos; one paratopy bridge A1-A2 replays as total 2 via conjugate (2,0,1)=2, others 0, matching draft. HOWEVER the presented theorem in inputs/DRAFT.md is false as written: 5 of the 12 printed row-strings are not Latin and not N2-free (parsed: A1 N2=6 non-Latin, A2 N2=3 non-Latin, B3 N2=2 non-Latin, B4 N2=3 non-Latin, C2 N2=4 non-Latin; only A3/A4/A5/B1/B2/B5/C1 match JSON). Thus the headline witness list does not certify. Second evidence defect: shipped verify.py does NOT verify the headline '12 pairwise non-isotopic / all 66 pairs': lines 89-90 pass without check for same-block pairs, so VERIFY_OK does not entail within-block distinctness (only cross-block). Draft claim 'all 66 pairs tested' is therefore not discharged by the shipped checker, even though independent recheck happens to confirm it for the JSON grids. Seed labels also off-by-one for 6 reps. Essential inference as presented fails. value: Target was exact N isotopy classes plus paratopy splitting across the 3 known N2-free main classes. Delivered is explicitly only lower bounds 5/5/2 from 57 randomized squares with no upper bound, and draft expressly disclaims identification of its 3 blocks with McKay's 3 N2-free main classes. The strongest self-contained exact facts (12 JSON grids are Latin N2=0 with distinct isotopy types, trans/aut per rep) are exact certifications of arbitrary sampled outputs, not exact invariants of a natural object motivated before computation: the 12 reps were generated by randomized DFS (seeds 1..59), are not canonical, and the numbers 5/5/2 depend on sampling effort (could be improved by more sampling; max per paratopy class is <=6 so 12/18 is an arbitrary slice). No general criterion, completed census, or downstream use is demonstrated; downstream quasigroup-table use is asserted only. Per the standard, certification alone does not rescue an arbitrary object or unexplained number, and an honestly-described incomplete census does not erase the need for an independently valuable exact headline — none is present here (the 3-block distinctness was already known as McKay's count 3; the 12 lower bound is not the sought invariant N). Hence intrinsically low value / missing substantive result.
